BL-1598 — BL-791 slice C, part 1 - BL-378's per-file 7 s gate has been permanently red since 2026-08 (9 offenders on 2026-09-16, 19 on 2026-08-22), which is why it stopped nothing: every npm test records result fail and a new pole is indistinguishable from an old one; a committed pole register (file, owner ticket, first seen, measured) makes the gate refuse only a NEW offender or a STALE row, npm test's recorded result tells test failures apart from budget verdicts, and the nine poles measured today enter the register owned by the epic
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. The operator delegated the lane budget decision to the specifier on 2026-09-16 (BL-791 slice C); the decision is recorded on the epic and in backlog/evidence/BL-791-slice-c-lane-budget-decisi…
BL-1598 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1598" (or "reject BL-1598 <reason>") to act.
